biography.value: Street criminals - muggers, gang members, hired muscle for criminal organizations. More dangerous than commoners due to actual combat training (Melee 3) and willingness to use violence. Criminal background gives them underworld contacts for fencing stolen goods.

system.tactics: Thugs rely on numbers and dirty fighting. They use Swift Movement to dart in, attack with allies nearby (triggering Exploit Weakness for +5 damage), then Disengage as a [Minor] action to avoid retaliation. Prefer ambushes from stealth (Stealth 3) and will flee if facing organized opposition or taking heavy damage.
system.attacksNotes:
Dagger [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 7 + Melee Combat 3), Reach: 5 ft

  • Margin 1:: 8 damage (4 + 4 Str)
  • Margin 2: 8 damage, DR halved (round up)

With Exploit Weakness: When ally within 5 ft of target OR subtracting from attack dice, add Dex 5 to damage Thrown (Range 30/60 ft): Use Dex 5 + Ranged Combat 3

  • Margin 1:: 8 damage (4 + 4 Str)
  • Margin 2: 8 damage, DR halved (round up)
system.specialAbilitiesNotes:
Feats

Swift Movement: Can Disengage or Hide using only 1 [Minor] action instead of a full action. Perfect for hit-and-run tactics. Danger Sense: Subtract 1 from both dice on Reflex saves against effects you can see. Represents street-smart reflexes. Exploit Weakness: Once per round, when attacking with an ally within 5 feet of target OR subtracting from attack dice (from any source), add Dexterity score (5) to damage. Purchased Feats: None (0 at TR 1/2)

Variants

Pickpocket: Leave Thievery at 4, leave Melee Combat at baseline rank 2 (omit it from the stat block), more focused on theft than combat, use Swift Movement to escape after stealing. Enforcer: Use Mercenary background for better combat training, represents gang muscle who collects debts and intimidates. Burglar: Raise Stealth 3→4 (24 XP), replace Danger Sense with Supreme Stealth feat when qualified at TR 2, focused on breaking and entering.
